name: get_customer
description: Look up a customer account by id or by email address and return their contact details, saved addresses and payment methods. The address_id and payment_method_id values returned here are the ones create_order accepts. Exactly one of customer_id or email must be supplied.

email.description: Email address on the account. Matched case-insensitively.

error_returns.when: Neither customer_id nor email was supplied.
No account matches the given customer_id or email.
